title: Purple Oni Warrior
description: A fierce purple-skinned oni demon stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. He has white spiky hair, black curved horns adorned with purple ribbons, sharp fangs, and wears traditional Japanese-inspired armor with spiral patterns, a skull pauldron, tattered white and purple hakama, and geta sandals.
prompt: A fierce purple-skinned oni demon with white spiky hair, black curved horns wrapped in purple ribbons, and sharp fangs, standing in a dynamic fighting stance. He wears ornate purple and white armor with spiral patterns, a skull shoulder plate, a skull belt buckle, tattered white hakama with purple trim, and purple geta sandals. His expression is menacing with a wide grin, one hand raised in a claw gesture. Solid gray background, clean anime-influenced digital art style.
